card.name: Each item, side or dose in distributive phrases
card.fires_on: The word each, or the noun or small word right after each or per (side, dose, strength, nostril, extremity, of, that). It marks a distributive phrase where something applies to every individual item.

modes.label: Each itself
modes.description: The word each opening a clause about every member of a group, mostly in botanical descriptions.
modes.example: involucral collars widely separated,<< each>> with 4-12 flowers;

modes.label: After each or per
modes.description: The noun or linking word that follows each or per, such as side, dose, strength or nostril.

modes.label: Per body part
modes.description: The body-part word completing a per-unit phrase in dosing text.
modes.example: Venography Per lower extrem<<ity>> 50 mL to 15

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning each one separately or individually, and away from words meaning as a whole.
card.plain: It lights up on 'each' and the words right after it, where the text is about every single item separately.
